cases.name: reports static mocks
cases.code:
vi.mock('./automocked')
  vi.mock('./factory', () => ({}))
  vi.mock('./original', async (importOriginal) => importOriginal())
  vi.mock('./spy', { spy: true })
  vi.unmock('./unmocked')
  vi.doUnmock('./do-unmocked')
  vi.importActual('./actual')
  vi.doMock('./do-mocked', () => ({}))

cases.name: hoists mock, unmock, hoisted
cases.code:
vi.mock('path', () => {})
  vi.unmock('path')
  vi.hoisted(() => {})

cases.name: always hoists import from vitest
cases.code:
import { vi } from 'vitest'
vi.mock('path', () => {})
vi.unmock('path')
vi.hoisted(() => {})
import { test } from 'vitest'

cases.name: always hoists all imports but they are under mocks
cases.code:
import { vi } from 'vitest'
  import { someValue } from './path.js'
  import { someValue2 } from './path2.js'
  vi.mock('path', () => {})
  vi.unmock('path')
  vi.hoisted(() => {})
  import { test } from 'vitest'

cases.name: correctly mocks namespaced

cases.name: correctly access import

import { vi } from 'vitest'
  import add from '../src/add'
  add();
  vi.mock('../src/add', () => {})
